== Book 3 ==

== Biography ==

Tiktok is a mechanical man, referred to as "the machine" and "the copper man," who moves only when his machinery has been wound. Invited by Ozma, he takes his seat in the drawing-room of the palace between the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman, opposite Ozma and Princess Langwidere. When the Tin Woodman describes the army being assembled to face the Nome King, Tiktok asks, "Why should you fight the Nome King?" Asked by Ozma whether he will join the party, Tiktok declares himself "the slave of the girl Dor-oth-y, who res-cued me from pris-on," adding, "Where she goes I will go."

Tiktok is reunited with the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman after a separation, squeezing the Tin Woodman's hand so earnestly that he dents some of the Tin Woodman's fingers. He is present at the coronation of King Evardo Fifteenth of Ev and, still claiming to belong to Dorothy, is permitted to join the party crossing the desert on Ozma's magic carpet after Dorothy winds his machinery as far as possible.

== Relationships ==

'''[[DOROTHY]]''' — Tiktok declares himself "the slave of the girl Dor-oth-y, who res-cued me from pris-on," indicating a bond of loyal service to her that leads him to follow wherever she goes.

'''[[Nome King]]''' — Tiktok questions the army mustered against the Nome King, asking "Why should you fight the Nome King?," which suggests an adversarial position within the expedition sent to confront him.

'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — Their shared presence in Ozma's court, seated together with the Tin Woodman, suggests a familiar acquaintance, though no direct exchange between them is recorded.

'''[[Ozma]]''' — Ozma's direct invitation for Tiktok to join her company, "Will you join our party?," suggests an acquaintance built on her welcome of him into the group.

'''[[Tin Woodman]]''' — The warmth of their reunion, in which Tiktok squeezes the Tin Woodman's hand "so earnestly that he dented some of his fingers," suggests a close friendship between them.

== References ==

<references/>

=== Events ===

* Ozma leads an expedition of Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Tiktok, Billina, the Cowardly Lion, and an army of Oz to free the Queen of Ev and her ten children from the Nome King.
* Ozma fails all eleven guesses and is transformed into an emerald grasshopper; the Tin Woodman, the army officers, and Tiktok are also transformed after failing their own guesses.
* The Tin Woodman is joyfully reunited with the Scarecrow and Tiktok, and the group returns to the royal palace of Ev.
* Ozma's party, including Dorothy, Tiktok, and Billina, crosses the desert on the magic carpet and travels to the Emerald City, meeting Jinjur (now a contented farm wife) along the way.

<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 6 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Book 6 ==

== Biography ==

Tiktok is a machine man who declares his intent to stand by Ozma, reasoning he "should be of no use at all in Kan-sas." Unlike some of his companions, he has no need to sleep, and is found wandering the palace grounds through the night beside the Tin Woodman and Jack Pumpkinhead until daybreak. He describes his own thinking as mechanical in nature, remarking, "I can on-ly think by ma-chin-er-y, so I do not pre-tend to know as much as you do," a modest assessment offered in response to another's claim of unexcelled wisdom.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Ozma]]''' — his declared intent to stand by her suggests a friendly bond, though it is not stated outright.

'''[[Jack Pumpkinhead]]''' — their shared company at the palace grounds and the Forbidden Fountain could indicate a friendly acquaintance.

'''[[Nick Chopper]]''' — appearing alongside him at the Forbidden Fountain suggests a friendly rapport, though nothing further is confirmed.

'''[[Omby Amby]]''' — the connection between them appears only as an indirect acquaintance.

'''[[Scarecrow]]''' — their shared night by the Forbidden Fountain suggests a friendly bond among the group.
</div>
